say:1:1460409001:1.text: Phew... It's like I just woke up from a lucid nightmare...
say:1:1460409001:1.source_cn: 呼……简直像做了一场清醒的噩梦……

say:2:1460409002:1.text: I'm sorry you have to see me in such an embarrassing state.
say:2:1460409002:1.source_cn: 我之前怎么会变成那样，真是见笑了。

choice_prompt:3:1460409002.text: I'm sorry you have to see me in such an embarrassing state.
choice_prompt:3:1460409002.source_cn: 我之前怎么会变成那样，真是见笑了。

say:4:1460409003:1.text: Actually, I was aware of my actions the whole time, but I just couldn't contain my anger.
say:4:1460409003:1.source_cn: 唉，之前的状况真的是，我思维是清醒的，但却无法抑制自己...

say:5:1460409004:1.text: I broke out in a sweat and my heart started pounding at the thought of revisions I needed to make. Before I knew it, I was screaming uncontrollably.
say:5:1460409004:1.source_cn: 光是想到还有要修改的内容，就浑身冒汗心跳加速，然后忍不...

say:6:1460409007:1.text: I feel bad for causing so much trouble for everyone...
say:6:1460409007:1.source_cn: 真是抱歉，给大家添了这么多麻烦……

say:8:1460409008:1.text: I didn't do much, to be honest. It's Harley who really picked up the slack for you.
say:8:1460409008:1.source_cn: 我倒是还好，哈尔乐可是帮你处理了不少事和手续。

say:9:1460409009:1.text: I hate to break this to you now, but you'll have to write another report for the mess you caused today.
say:9:1460409009:1.source_cn: 尽管这会儿说这个多少有些不近人情了，但你这次闹出来的事...

say:10:1460409010:1.text: Hmm... I understand. Anyway, thanks for taking care of me.
say:10:1460409010:1.source_cn: 呼……我知道的，席蕾，多谢你的照顾，也谢谢你，哈尔乐队...

say:11:1460409011:1.text: I'll head back and catch up on all the backlog of work.
say:11:1460409011:1.source_cn: 我回去就会补充好检讨，之前要修改的地方也会改好再提交。

say:13:1460409012:1.text: You're handling this way better than I expected! I was all set for another outburst, honestly!
say:13:1460409012:1.source_cn: ……我还以为刚刚你会再发作，都做好再制服你的准备了，没...

say:14:1460409013:1.text: I must give credit to the Magister's potion. I have to admit, I felt a surge of anger when you mentioned work just now.
say:14:1460409013:1.source_cn: 是的，这位魔法师大人的药剂真是十分神奇，我刚刚听到要写...
say:14:1460409013:1.male: I must give credit to the Magister's potion. I have to admit, I felt a surge of anger when you mentioned work just now.
say:14:1460409013:1.female: I must give credit to the Magister's potion. I have to admit, I felt a surge of anger when you mentioned work just now.

say:15:1460409014:1.text: But a wave of refreshing coolness washed over me the next second, immediately cooling my mind.
say:15:1460409014:1.source_cn: 但立刻心头就泛起了清凉的感觉，脑子也转得非常快。

say:16:1460409015:1.text: Suddenly, it hit me that all the revisions I had to make were simple and didn't take much time at all.
say:16:1460409015:1.source_cn: 我立刻就意识到：之前给出的修改规章都很简单，并不需要很...

say:17:1460409016:1.text: No one's picking on me, and it's just the way things go with work.
say:17:1460409016:1.source_cn: 写好的报告被打回来也并不代表我这个人被否认，只是一份工...

say:18:1460409017:1.text: Wow! Seems like that potion has cured you completely! How amazing!
say:18:1460409017:1.source_cn: ……你还真是，彻底痊愈了啊？！就喝了那么一瓶药水？！这...

say:19:1460409018:1.text: I think I got swept up in this anxiety partly because some of my colleagues were feeling the same way...
say:19:1460409018:1.source_cn: 其实，我之前有些焦躁，有一部分原因也是其他同僚也陷入了...

say:20:1460409019:1.text: They didn't have a nervous breakdown like I did, but they've been dealing with headaches and feeling irritable too...
say:20:1460409019:1.source_cn: 有的人只是没像我之前那样难以自控，但有的人也头痛不已甚...

say:21:1460409020:1.text: It'd be great if I could <style="highlight">share this incredible potion with them</style>...
say:21:1460409020:1.source_cn: 如果这份神奇的药<style=highlight>能推...

say:22:1460409021:1.text: Once again, I apologize for making things difficult for everyone.
say:22:1460409021:1.source_cn: 再次道歉，给大家添了这么多麻烦。

say:23:1460409022:1.text: No worries! You can return to the squad after having enough rest.
say:23:1460409022:1.source_cn: 没事，你现在已经痊愈了，队员们也都在等你归队，早点休息好吧。

say:25:1460409023:1.text: Now, I need to escort Kocher to Ravion's place to write a more detailed report. We guards take discipline very seriously.
say:25:1460409023:1.source_cn: 嗯，我得押送他到沙利叶那去写个更详细的报告，现在卫兵闹...

say:26:1460409024:1.text: Harley, could you wrap things up here?
say:26:1460409024:1.source_cn: 哈尔乐，这里的后续处理就交给你了。

say:29:1460409005:1.text: Yeah, I was fully aware of myself earlier, but my emotions got the better of me.
say:29:1460409005:1.source_cn: 是的，我此前的意识是清醒的，只是情绪占据了上风。

say:30:1460409006:1.text: The thought of revising my work pushed me over the edge, and I couldn't help but shout.
say:30:1460409006:1.source_cn: 光想到要修改就完全崩溃，大吼大叫，根本无法控制自己了。
